_doc: woollama's default MCP server configuration — Claude-Code-shaped.
_doc2: Override by writing your own to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/woollama/mcp.json. Env var substitution: ${VAR} is expanded at load time. ${WOOLLAMA_EXAMPLES_DIR} resolves to the package's examples/ directory; useful only in these bundled defaults. The ':-' form gives a fallback when a variable is unset or empty (POSIX semantics) -- used below so a binary-only install, which has no examples/, declares that absence deliberately rather than looking like a missing-variable mistake.
